headline_for_paper: Starting from a fresh ASTA deep-research PDF and a held-out curator ground truth, the blinded pipeline recovered the correct WMBv1 cluster target within the deterministic top-4 for all 4 discovered targets, and the agent promoted the correct target to a top-<=3 survivor for 3 of 4 (candelabrum recovered both parent supertype and child cluster). The one weak case (basket) is a genuinely cross-cutting morphology-vs-transcriptomics mismatch flagged by the curator's own CrossCuttingMatch label. Confidence was conservatively calibrated (no HIGH without experimental evidence), the anti-hallucination guard caught and corrected real synthesis errors before write-back, and a leakage audit confirmed the blind was uncompromised.
